headline: RIR Power Electronics reports 41 percent higher Q2 profit despite stock hitting a 52-week low
hook: Profits jump as stock hits yearly low
summary: RIR Power Electronics announced its Q2 FY27 financial results, reporting a 41 percent increase in profit after tax alongside a 32.5 percent year-on-year growth in operational revenue to ₹33.98 crore. Despite the financial growth, the company's stock touched a 52-week low on the exchanges. Indian retail investors tracking small-cap power electronics firms must weigh headline profit expansion against downward stock momentum.
why_it_matters: Strong earnings mismatch with weak share price performance for retail holders
winners_losers: RIR Power holders see mixed signals

headline: RIR Power Electronics releases second quarter financial results

headline: RIR Power Electronics files AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: AGM voting results submitted to exchanges
summary: RIR Power Electronics Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 29, 2026.
